name: vercel-deploy-status
description: Pins the Vercel deploy queue of the linked project under the prompt: every deploy queued, building or just finished, with its phase and elapsed time

activePollSeconds.description: How often to ask Vercel while a deploy is in flight
activePollSeconds.title: Active poll (seconds)

idlePollSeconds.description: How often to ask Vercel while no deploy is in flight
idlePollSeconds.title: Idle poll (seconds)

holdFinishedMinutes.description: How long a finished deploy stays on the line before it clears
holdFinishedMinutes.title: Hold finished (minutes)

watchAfterPushMinutes.description: How long to poll at the active rate after a push or a merge, waiting for the deploy to appear
watchAfterPushMinutes.title: Watch after push (minutes)

maxRows.description: How many deploys to list before folding the rest into a count
maxRows.title: Max rows
